sections.heading: Road to Recovery Clinic - Center Overview

blocks.text: Road to Recovery Clinic is dedicated to helping individuals overcome substance, drug and alcohol abuse. The private rehab, located in Midland, Ontario offers a comprehensive range of treatments that are designed to address the unique needs of each person receiving care. The clinic’s team of experienced professionals utilize evidence-based practices in addition to holistic therapies such as yoga, meditation, and art therapy to ensure that each individual is provided with personalized care that is tailored to their specific needs.
blocks.html: Road to Recovery Clinic is dedicated to helping individuals overcome substance, drug and alcohol abuse. The private rehab, located in Midland, Ontario offers a comprehensive range of treatments that are designed to address the unique needs of each person receiving care. The clinic’s team of experienced professionals utilize evidence-based practices in addition to holistic therapies such as yoga, meditation, and art therapy to ensure that each individual is provided with personalized care that is tailored to their specific needs.

blocks.text: At Road to Recovery Clinic, there is a focus on treating the whole person, rather than just the addiction or substance abuse. This means that in addition to traditional therapy approaches, nutritional counseling, and family therapy are integrated into each patient’s treatment plan. Through group therapy and counseling, individuals are provided with the opportunity to connect with others experiencing similar struggles, allowing them to build a supportive community throughout their journey to recovery. With the help of the team at Road to Recovery Clinic, individuals can work towards lifelong recovery and regain control of their lives.

blocks.text: What is methadone and how does it work?
Methadone is an opioid agonist used to manage opioid addiction. It works by reducing cravings and withdrawal symptoms while blocking the effects of other opioids.
blocks.html: Methadone is an opioid agonist used to manage opioid addiction. It works by reducing cravings and withdrawal symptoms while blocking the effects of other opioids.

blocks.text: What is Suboxone® and how does it work?
Suboxone® is a combination of buprenorphine and naloxone used to manage opioid addiction. It works by easing withdrawal symptoms and reducing the effects of other opioids.
blocks.html: Suboxone® is a combination of buprenorphine and naloxone used to manage opioid addiction. It works by easing withdrawal symptoms and reducing the effects of other opioids.

blocks.text: What is Kadian® and how does it work?
Kadian® is an extended-release form of morphine used to manage severe pain. It works by blocking pain signals sent to the brain.

centre.about_html:
Road to Recovery Health Clinics™ (RTR) is a renowned rehab center in Ontario, established with the sole purpose of aiding those affected by opioid addiction. With years of experience and a team of dedicated healthcare professionals, RTR has successfully helped numerous individuals recover from opioid addiction.

 

RTR specializes in providing highly effective and safe opioid addiction treatments that include methadone, Suboxone®, and Kadian®, among others. Furthermore, we offer alcohol addiction treatment, smoking cessation, and mental health services to give our clients the best possible treatment.

Outpatient Opioid Detoxification Centers Locations Across the Province

At RTR, we operate several outpatient opioid detoxification centers across the province, providing clients with easy access to our services. Our clinics are fully equipped, and our staff is highly trained and caring, making the recovery process much more comfortable.

Finding Your Mental Toughness with RTR: The SISU Philosophy

To help our clients achieve full recovery, we follow the Finnish principle of “SISU.” This philosophy aims to find your “second wind” of mental toughness when you are reaching your physical and mental limits. Our goal is to be with you all the way on your Road to Recovery, be it mental, physical, or emotional.

Our Commitment to You: Professionalism, Skills, Empathy, Trust, Community, and Digital Access

At RTR, we are committed to providing the best possible care to our clients. Our commitment includes:

 

Professionalism: Our team of healthcare professionals is efficient and courteous.

Skills: Our extensive knowledge and experience exceed the standard of care.

Empathy: We always have our clients’ best interests at heart, and their concerns are our concerns.

Trust: Our clients’ concerns are private and confidential, and we make sure they feel heard, understood, and addressed.

Community: We are committed to helping the communities we serve and are more than just a medical clinic.

Digital Access: We offer digital medicine services to transform healthcare and make it more accessible.




Road to Recovery Clinic - Center Overview

Road to Recovery Clinic is dedicated to helping individuals overcome substance, drug and alcohol abuse. The private rehab, located in Midland, Ontario offers a comprehensive range of treatments that are designed to address the unique needs of each person receiving care. The clinic’s team of experienced professionals utilize evidence-based practices in addition to holistic therapies such as yoga, meditation, and art therapy to ensure that each individual is provided with personalized care that is tailored to their specific needs.

At Road to Recovery Clinic, there is a focus on treating the whole person, rather than just the addiction or substance abuse. This means that in addition to traditional therapy approaches, nutritional counseling, and family therapy are integrated into each patient’s treatment plan. Through group therapy and counseling, individuals are provided with the opportunity to connect with others experiencing similar struggles, allowing them to build a supportive community throughout their journey to recovery. With the help of the team at Road to Recovery Clinic, individuals can work towards lifelong recovery and regain control of their lives.

Frequently Asked Questions About Road to Recovery Clinic

What services does RTR offer?

RTR provides highly effective opioid addiction treatments, including methadone, Suboxone®, and Kadian®, as well as alcohol addiction treatment, smoking cessation, and mental health services.

What is the SISU philosophy?

SISU aims to help individuals find their “second wind” of mental toughness when they are reaching their physical and mental limits.

What makes RTR unique?

RTR stands out from other rehab centers due to its commitment to professionalism, skills, empathy, trust, community, and digital access.

What is methadone and how does it work?

Methadone is an opioid agonist used to manage opioid addiction. It works by reducing cravings and withdrawal symptoms while blocking the effects of other opioids.

What is Suboxone® and how does it work?

Suboxone® is a combination of buprenorphine and naloxone used to manage opioid addiction. It works by easing withdrawal symptoms and reducing the effects of other opioids.

What is Kadian® and how does it work?

Kadian® is an extended-release form of morphine used to manage severe pain. It works by blocking pain signals sent to the brain.

Does RTR offer telemedicine services?

Yes, we offer digital access services, including telemedicine, to provide our clients with easy access to our services.

raw_html:
Road to Recovery Health Clinics™ (RTR) is a renowned rehab center in Ontario, established with the sole purpose of aiding those affected by opioid addiction. With years of experience and a team of dedicated healthcare professionals, RTR has successfully helped numerous individuals recover from opioid addiction.

 

RTR specializes in providing highly effective and safe opioid addiction treatments that include methadone, Suboxone®, and Kadian®, among others. Furthermore, we offer alcohol addiction treatment, smoking cessation, and mental health services to give our clients the best possible treatment.

Outpatient Opioid Detoxification Centers Locations Across the Province

At RTR, we operate several outpatient opioid detoxification centers across the province, providing clients with easy access to our services. Our clinics are fully equipped, and our staff is highly trained and caring, making the recovery process much more comfortable.

Finding Your Mental Toughness with RTR: The SISU Philosophy

To help our clients achieve full recovery, we follow the Finnish principle of “SISU.” This philosophy aims to find your “second wind” of mental toughness when you are reaching your physical and mental limits. Our goal is to be with you all the way on your Road to Recovery, be it mental, physical, or emotional.

Our Commitment to You: Professionalism, Skills, Empathy, Trust, Community, and Digital Access

At RTR, we are committed to providing the best possible care to our clients. Our commitment includes:

 

Professionalism: Our team of healthcare professionals is efficient and courteous.

Skills: Our extensive knowledge and experience exceed the standard of care.

Empathy: We always have our clients’ best interests at heart, and their concerns are our concerns.

Trust: Our clients’ concerns are private and confidential, and we make sure they feel heard, understood, and addressed.

Community: We are committed to helping the communities we serve and are more than just a medical clinic.

Digital Access: We offer digital medicine services to transform healthcare and make it more accessible.




Road to Recovery Clinic - Center Overview

Road to Recovery Clinic is dedicated to helping individuals overcome substance, drug and alcohol abuse. The private rehab, located in Midland, Ontario offers a comprehensive range of treatments that are designed to address the unique needs of each person receiving care. The clinic’s team of experienced professionals utilize evidence-based practices in addition to holistic therapies such as yoga, meditation, and art therapy to ensure that each individual is provided with personalized care that is tailored to their specific needs.

At Road to Recovery Clinic, there is a focus on treating the whole person, rather than just the addiction or substance abuse. This means that in addition to traditional therapy approaches, nutritional counseling, and family therapy are integrated into each patient’s treatment plan. Through group therapy and counseling, individuals are provided with the opportunity to connect with others experiencing similar struggles, allowing them to build a supportive community throughout their journey to recovery. With the help of the team at Road to Recovery Clinic, individuals can work towards lifelong recovery and regain control of their lives.
